verdict.rationale: Honeycomb ingests traces, logs, and metrics via OpenTelemetry (honeycomb-docs-1, honeycomb-docs-31). It stores traces and logs as structured events that are auto-indexed and queryable together, with relational span fields (honeycomb-docs-52, honeycomb-docs-17). That implies correlation is possible through queries, and the demo mentions correlating app and Kubernetes errors (honeycomb-docs-54). However, no evidence documents a one-click jump from a span to its related logs and metrics. One community user still debugs across Honeycomb traces, separate log storage, and Prometheus metrics, and says no single tool ties these together (honeycomb-comm-2). Missing for 10: a documented span-to-logs/metrics navigation workflow, evidence of metrics correlated to trace context, and independent hands-on corroboration of end-to-end request debugging across all three signals.
